meta.name: api-design-reviewer
meta.description: Comprehensive REST API design review with automated linting, breaking-change detection, and design scorecards. Catches inconsistent conventions, missing versioning, and design smells before APIs ship. Use when reviewing a PR that adds or changes API endpoints, auditing an existing API for v2 migration, or establishing API standards for a team.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查 API 设计规范,自动检测破坏性变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常评审 API 变更或制定团队接口规范
copy.tagline_en: Review API design, detect breaking changes automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review API changes or set team API conventions

howto.what: 装上后,审查 API 设计时 Claude 会运行三个工具:检查 OpenAPI/Swagger 规范的合规性、对比两个版本找破坏性变更、给设计质量打 A–F 等级分,最后汇总问题清单与评分,并指导修复直到全部通过。
howto.when: 在审查新增或修改 API 端点的 PR、审计现有 API 为 v2 迁移做准备、为团队制定 API 标准时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这份 openapi.json,列出不合规的地方
say.note: 会运行 linter 并列出违规点与修改建议。

say.text: 对比 v1 和 v2 两份 API 规范,找出破坏性变更
say.note: 会运行对比脚本找出变更并评估影响。

say.text: 给这个 API 设计打分,目标不低于 B 级
say.note: 会生成评分表与各项改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude runs three review tools: lints OpenAPI specs for violations, detects breaking changes between versions, and scores design quality (A-F). It reports findings and guides fixes until all checks pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when reviewing a PR that adds or changes API endpoints, auditing an existing API for v2 migration, or establishing API standards for a team.

say_en.text: Review this openapi.json and list what violates REST conventions.
say_en.note: Runs the linter and outputs violations with fixes.

say_en.text: Compare v1 and v2 API specs and point out breaking changes.
say_en.note: Uses the breaking-change detector to compare both versions.

say_en.text: Score this API design; I want at least a B grade.
say_en.note: Runs the scorecard and gives scores plus tips.
